def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    from collections import defaultdict
    # collect diagonal lines: down-right direction and down-left direction
    for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
        for start_r in range(h):
            for start_c in range(w):
                # top end of a line: cell whose up-neighbor in this diagonal is different/out
                pr,pc=start_r-dr,start_c-dc
                if 0<=pr<h and 0<=pc<w and g[pr][pc]==g[start_r][start_c]: continue

                if length>=2:
                    # extend upward beyond start
                    r,c=start_r-dr,start_c-dc
                    while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:
                        out[r][c]=col; r-=dr; c-=dc
    return out

from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
        for start_r in range(h):
            for start_c in range(w):
                pr,pc=start_r-dr,start_c-dc
                if 0<=pr<h and 0<=pc<w and g[pr][pc]==g[start_r][start_c]: continue
                col=g[start_r][start_c]
                if col==bg: continue
                length=0; r,c=start_r,start_c
                while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w and g[r][c]==col:
                    length+=1; r+=dr; c+=dc
                if length>=2:
                    r,c=start_r-dr,start_c-dc
                    while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:
                        out[r][c]=col; r-=dr; c-=dc
    return out
